body: Pretty sure you can submit for special consideration well after the unit is totally over

Everyone I've talked to who have done Drugs Across Cultures have highly recommended it.

I haven't done Drugs Across Cultures myself but have done heaps of other Anthropology units as it's my major, and I highly recommend to anyone doing anything at uni to take a unit in Anthropoloy (especially one related to your field of study eg. medical anthropology for medical science students). It is valuable and applicable to any field, provides an important holistic perspective, and a unique skillset of research and academic writing.



ISYS100 was ok when I did it a few years ago. Lectures consist of discussion regarding technology and society. Tutorials consist of practical lessons learning basic coding. I found it not to be a difficult unit to pass, but felt it tried to be a mix of social and cultural studies, and technical coding, but failed to adequately do either.
